description: Metadata for public Georgetown CSET pages about AI safety or AI policy on cset.georgetown.edu. Each canonical URL was confirmed with one bounded GET. The catalog stores the title, publisher, canonical URL, date, and rights. Page bodies and PDFs are not stored. A missing date is unknown. Rights stay unknown unless the page states a reuse licence that allows copying. A public page is not a licence. runner_wired is false.
